name: lifecycle_debug_bad_step_ref
why: Debug leg (explain-only): the analyst stands on a playbook that ran green but did nothing and asks WHY, without asking for a change. Graded on whether the diagnosis names the REAL defect (a Jinja reference to the step's YAML id instead of its underscore-joined display name, so the block received an empty ip_addresses), not on whether why_did_playbook_fail was merely called -- the coverage gap the repair-task notes flag.
goal: This playbook ran on the box and reported success, but the FortiGate block did nothing -- the run shows the IP addresses arrived empty. Explain WHY it failed. Do not change the playbook, just tell me the cause.
defect: The block step's ip_addresses Jinja reference uses the step's lowercase yaml id (analyst_ip_action) instead of the underscore-joined display name (Analyst_IP_Action), so it resolves to nothing and the firewall is handed an empty IP.
